agent-pipeline run <runId> · <duration>

  merged   #3 Run: drain the Frontier (PR #12)
  handed   #5 Fix Stage with a single retry · verify · 1 unmet
  released #6 Rebase conflict resolution · rate limit at implement
  skipped  #7 no-criteria
  skipped  #9 blocked

Frontier empty.

The verb is padded to nine columns so the Ticket numbers line up. A Run that
took no Ticket prints `  nothing to do` in place of the rows.

`skipped` names why a candidate was passed over: `blocked` for one an open
blocker held back all Run, and otherwise the guard reason that kept it from
being claimed — `spec`, `no-criteria` or `body-only-blockers` for Planning a
guard rejected, `claimed` or `not-ready` for an issue `ticket <n>` named that no
Run may take.

The last line says why the Run stopped: `Frontier empty.` when nothing is left,
`Frontier blocked.` when every remaining candidate has an open blocker.

`ticket <n>` prints the same header and its one row, and stops there: it drains
no Frontier, so it says nothing about one.
